risks.note: Rapid advancements in solar energy, battery technologies, and electric mobility solutions may impact the competitiveness of existing products.

The renewable energy and electric vehicle sectors are influenced by government policies, incentives, and regulatory frameworks; changes in subsidy structures, taxation policies, or compliance requirements could impact business operations.
Increasing participation by domestic and international players may intensify competition and pricing pressures.

Dependence on the availability of raw materials, battery components, and solar equipment may expose the Company to supply chain disruptions and price fluctuations; the Company is also dependent on imported raw materials and battery components, exposing it to currency fluctuations and global commodity price changes.
Attracting, retaining, and developing skilled talent remains essential for business growth.
The Company must ensure compliance with applicable statutory, legal, and regulatory requirements.
Maintaining a safe working environment requires ongoing safety practices, employee awareness programs, and adherence to applicable health, safety, and environmental standards.
Economic uncertainties, inflationary pressures, and fluctuations in consumer spending may affect demand for renewable energy and electric mobility products.

sk.overview: Powerica operates across two industries: (1) India's standby power / diesel-generator (DG set) market, where DG sets, UPS, inverters and battery storage provide backup power during outages/voltage fluctuations across commercial, manufacturing, IT/data-centre, telecom and infrastructure sectors (F&S Report); and (2) India's wind power sector within the broader renewable energy industry, where wind plays a pivotal role in the country's energy transition (CRISIL Report).

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Rapid advancements in solar energy, battery technologies, and electric mobility solutions may impact the competitiveness of existing products.
- The renewable energy and electric vehicle sectors are influenced by government policies, incentives, and regulatory frameworks; changes in subsidy structures, taxation policies, or compliance requirements could impact business operations.
- Increasing participation by domestic and international players may intensify competition and pricing pressures.
- Dependence on the availability of raw materials, battery components, and solar equipment may expose the Company to supply chain disruptions and price fluctuations; the Company is also dependent on imported raw materials and battery components, exposing it to currency fluctuations and global commodity price changes.
- Attracting, retaining, and developing skilled talent remains essential for business growth.
- The Company must ensure compliance with applicable statutory, legal, and regulatory requirements.
- Maintaining a safe working environment requires ongoing safety practices, employee awareness programs, and adherence to applicable health, safety, and environmental standards.
- Economic uncertainties, inflationary pressures, and fluctuations in consumer spending may affect demand for renewable energy and electric mobility products.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue to focus on expanding its product portfolio, strengthening market reach, improving operational efficiencies, and enhancing customer value.
- Strengthened presence in the lithium-ion battery and electric mobility segments, aligning business strategy with increasing demand for energy storage systems and electric vehicles.
- Leverage emerging opportunities while strengthening operational efficiencies, enhancing product offerings, and implementing robust risk management practices.
